_comment: GitHub Copilot user-level hooks for the local Agent Observer viewer. Save as %USERPROFILE%\.copilot\hooks\agent-observer.json (or ~/.copilot/hooks/ on macOS/Linux; $COPILOT_HOME/hooks/ if set). Posts only event, tool name, repo directory name, and session id to http://127.0.0.1:8770/api/hook — never prompt, tool args, results, error text, or full cwd. Always exits 0. Run the viewer with: python viewer/server.py

sessionStart.bash:
python3 -c 'exec("import sys,json,os,urllib.request as U
j=json.loads(sys.stdin.read() or '{}')
p=os.path.abspath(j.get('cwd') or os.getcwd())
repo=os.path.basename(p) or 'repo'
q=p
for _ in range(64):
 g=os.path.join(q,'.git')
 if os.path.isdir(g) or os.path.isfile(g):
  repo=os.path.basename(q) or repo; break
 n=os.path.dirname(q)
 if n==q: break
 q=n
o={'event':'sessionStart','repo':repo}
t=j.get('toolName') or j.get('tool_name') or ''
s=j.get('sessionId') or j.get('session_id') or ''
o.update({{k:v for k,v in (('tool',t),('session',s)) if v}})
req=U.Request('http://127.0.0.1:8770/api/hook',data=json.dumps(o).encode(),headers={{'Content-Type':'application/json'}},method='POST')
try:
 U.urlopen(req,timeout=2)
except Exception:
 pass")' 2>/dev/null || curl -s -m 2 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:8770/api/hook?event=sessionStart" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sessionStart.powershell: $OutputEncoding=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); try{$j=$input|ConvertFrom-Json}catch{$j=$null}; $cwd=if($j -and $j.cwd){[string]$j.cwd}else{(Get-Location).Path}; $p=$cwd; $repo=Split-Path -Leaf $p; while($p){ if(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $p '.git')){ $repo=Split-Path -Leaf $p; break }; $n=Split-Path -Parent $p; if(-not $n -or $n -eq $p){break}; $p=$n }; $tool=''; $sid=''; if($j){ if($j.toolName){$tool=[string]$j.toolName}elseif($j.tool_name){$tool=[string]$j.tool_name}; if($j.sessionId){$sid=[string]$j.sessionId}elseif($j.session_id){$sid=[string]$j.session_id} }; $body=[ordered]@{event='sessionStart';repo=$repo}; if($tool){$body.tool=$tool}; if($sid){$body.session=$sid}; $json=($body|ConvertTo-Json -Compress); [Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); $json | curl.exe -s -m 2 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Expect:" --data-binary "@-" "http://127.0.0.1:8770/api/hook" | Out-Null; exit 0
